lines.zh: 我慢慢从熔岩里升起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly out of the lava.
My arms hang very long.
I am wider than the whole lava surface.
I drift forward pushing heat.
I cross the fire lake from end to end.

lines.zh: 我的身体拖出一条火线。
lines.en: My body leaves a line of fire.
I pass close under the ceiling.
I go round a stone pillar slowly.
My arm tips graze the rock wall.
I move deeper into the Nether.

lines.zh: 我一动，周围就冒出新的鱿鱼。
lines.en: When I move, new squids rise around me.
I drift slower than this cave.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆流的方向走。
lines.en: I follow the lava's flow.
The stone glows as I pass.

lines.zh: 我从下面顶起一层热气。
lines.en: I push up a layer of hot air.

lines.zh: 我移动到你要经过的地方。
lines.en: I move to where you must pass.
I hang like a cloud of fire.
My arms sway open.
I wait for them to grow.
I stay still; the heat keeps spreading.
I draw my body in a little.
I listen for any sound of water.

lines.zh: 我的同伴在我周围浮着。
lines.en: My brood floats around me.

lines.zh: 我把一条触手绕在石柱上。
lines.en: I coil one arm around a pillar.
No hurry; this is all mine.
I look up at the rock ceiling.
My flames slowly gather.

lines.zh: 我在等某个不该来的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something that should not come.
I lower my eyes to you.

lines.zh: 你连我一条触手都比不上。
lines.en: You are smaller than one of my arms.
I turn slowly toward you.
I make a very low sound.
You should not be standing here.

lines.zh: 我的触手在你头顶张开。
lines.en: My arms spread over your head.
I fix on you and my fire reddens.
I lift my body up, high.
I have seen exactly what you wear.
I need no greeting.
My flames shudder.
I slide back half a block.
Several arms curl up.
I sink a little and my fire draws in.

lines.zh: 我的身体缺了一块焦的。
lines.en: A scorched piece is missing from me.
I slowly right my body.

lines.zh: 周围的鱿鱼散开了一点。
lines.en: The squids around me scatter slightly.
I pull all my arms back.
I stare at you and my fire grows.
I gather my fire again.
I have no interest in eating that.
I lift a hand and it burns.

lines.zh: 我绕过你递过来的东西。
lines.en: I go around what you offer.
The fire lacks nothing of that.
I scorch it to ash.
I look two seconds and drift off.
I do not make deals with anyone.
I press it into the lava.
My arm flicks it aside.
Do not try to coax me with those.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，被烫得弹开。
lines.en: You hit me and bounce off, burned.
My arm blocks you aside.
My body is harder than the pillar.

lines.zh: 热气把你推得退了三格。
lines.en: The heat pushes you back three blocks.

lines.zh: 你碰到的地方立刻起泡。
lines.en: The spot you touch blisters.
You barely move me.
I shift aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我们之间冒出一片白汽。
lines.en: A cloud of steam rises between us.
My brood crowds in.

lines.zh: 两条巨大的影子在火里相遇。
lines.en: Two vast shadows meet in the fire.
Our arms tangle together.
We sink into the lava together.
Its eyes come level with mine.
Our fires merge.
We float side by side on the fire lake.

lines.zh: 我们一起升起，又一起落下。
lines.en: We rise and settle together.
My arm tip touches its own.
Not a word passes between us.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝岩壁那边漂。
lines.en: We drift toward the rock wall together.
I curl two arms around it.
It glows red in my arms.

lines.zh: 我一生就是一窝熔岩鱿鱼。
lines.en: Every spawn of mine is more lava squid.
I toss it into the lava.
I carry it across the fire lake.
It melts between my arms.
I tuck it beneath me.
I coil it and turn once.
I let go and it falls into the fire.
I stop every motion.
I have already fixed on you.
I give one long sound.

lines.zh: 周围的鱿鱼都朝这边来。
lines.en: The squids all come this way.
Fire gathers beneath me.
I begin dropping lower.
You have been remembered by me.
Every arm of mine points at you.
I make the fire lake brighter.
This time I handle it myself.
I follow you, slowly.
You run along the fire lake.
My brood keeps following you.
I wait at the cave mouth for your return.
I make this whole stretch hotter.
You back to the wall; I press in.

lines.zh: 我的触手在你附近垂着。
lines.en: My arms hang near you.
You hear a great deal of crackling.
I press downward bit by bit.
I turn and my fireballs turn with me.
I spit a huge fireball.
I spit three fireballs in a row.
My arm knocks you over.

lines.zh: 我整个压下来，热得可怕。
lines.en: I press down, terribly hot.

lines.zh: 火顺着地面烧到你脚下。
lines.en: Fire runs along the ground to your feet.
My arm coils your waist.
You are flung to the lava's edge.
I follow with a smaller shot.
I rear up and slam down.
Something bulges in the middle of the fire lake.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里升上来，很高。
lines.en: I rise out of the lava, very tall.

lines.zh: 这一层的温度忽然翻倍。
lines.en: The temperature on this level doubles.
A ring of small squids rises around me.
You hear the lava churning.
The ceiling stone cracks from heat.
My arms break the lava surface first.
I begin to exist in the Nether.
The distant torches all go out.

lines.zh: 我的火光照亮了整个洞。
lines.en: My firelight fills the whole cave.
Fire is only a little hotter to me.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，触手翻成一团。
lines.en: I crash down and my arms tangle.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我整团熄了一层。
lines.en: Water hits me and a layer goes dark.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的火吹散了半边。
lines.en: The blast scatters half my fire.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我身体，冒着烟。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me, smoking.

lines.zh: 那股力量压住了我身的火。
lines.en: That force smothers the fire in me.
Hunger keeps me from floating; I sink.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，整个洞都白了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the cave goes white.

lines.zh: 下面的火没了，我一路坠下去。
lines.en: The fire below is gone; I fall.
